description: This file implements a POSIX-specific file enumerator class for traversing directories and files, including functions for retrieving file info, pattern matching, and directory traversal logic.

classes.name: FileEnumerator::FileInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a file, including its name, size, last modified time, and directory status.

methods.name: GetStat
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a file, following symlinks if specified.

methods.name: FileEnumerator::FileInfo::FileInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing file info with default values.

methods.name: FileEnumerator::FileInfo::IsDirectory
methods.description: Checks if the file info corresponds to a directory.

methods.name: FileEnumerator::FileInfo::GetSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: FileEnumerator::Next
methods.description: Returns the next file path in the enumeration.

methods.name: FileEnumerator::GetInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the current file.

methods.name: FileEnumerator::IsPatternMatched
methods.description: Checks if a filename matches the pattern.
